continuity_contract.enduring_objective: Improve reusable ARE reasoning, useful continuity, recovery, correctness and completed outcomes within cumulative model input plus output tokens.
continuity_contract.initial_objective: Finish GLM-5.3-flash qualification, beginning with the 8K small context window and useful reasoning-state recovery under pressure.
continuity_contract.research_method: objective → gap → question → competing hypotheses → selection → experiment/tasks/criteria → results → observations → reviewed decision → successor

dataset_refs: same exposed eight-task cohort for development; no reserved confirmation
experiment_template.research_question: Does a shared-prefix post-recycle fork distinguish causal ARE state benefit from pre-exposure model variance?
stop_conditions: Any snapshot or pre-treatment identity mismatch stops the pair.
No threshold or state-content change within the causal study.
Retain every repetition and never select a lucky seed.

records.falsifier: Branches differ before treatment, snapshot clone changes any bound state, control sees state, treatment lacks its declared presentation, repeated branch estimates remain too unstable for the fixed threshold, or the design cannot account every model input/output token.
records.mechanism: Run one common prefix until an actual recycle boundary, freeze its task, repository, delivery, ledger and prompt state, then clone it into control and treatment branches. Apply state only to treatment on the first post-boundary dispatch. Repeat branch pairs from exact prefix snapshots and randomize branch order; score treatment effects only after exposure.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Forking control and state from the same exact pre-recycle GLM-5.3-flash 8K trajectory and repeating post-boundary branches makes ContextBench state effects causally identifiable within cumulative model input plus output tokens.

records.research_question: Does a shared-prefix post-recycle fork distinguish causal ARE state benefit from pre-exposure model variance?
stop_conditions: Any prefix that terminates before its first recycle is retained as instrument-ineligible and is not replaced.
Any snapshot, ancestry, common-policy, receipt or pre-treatment identity mismatch stops that task before branch dispatch.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, state content, repetition count, order, replacement, or lucky rerun.
Record every prefix and branch model input/output token; unknown usage makes the pair ineligible.

records.claim: Two valid shared prefixes produced twelve branches with identical ancestry, but all branches stopped before post-boundary model dispatch because resume skipped output-deferral candidate rendering. A third prefix was stopped with one pending request of unknown usage. No state presentation or treatment effect occurred.
limitations: Native selection, semantic retention, correctness and transfer were not tested.
Round 15 is incomplete and decision-ineligible for H25.

records.next_action: Preserve Round 15. Add a durable post-recycle candidate-rendering phase whose resumed request matches uninterrupted execution, prove it offline, then freeze a separate Round 16 with unchanged cohort, state content, repetitions, order and criteria.
